# Yuzu: making a valued relation workable without inventing unlimited capacity

This model operates in relationship-motivated learning, familiar peer coordination/timing-sensitive inquiry, selected festival work, ordinary taste/friend consultation, partial-information birthday/event work, and the separately witnessed V11–V12 burden/participation states. The governing distinction is **a relationship she chooses, work she can do, and work she can sustainably be asked to absorb**. Choosing the first and demonstrating the second do not settle the third. A model must still produce useful ordinary acts rather than treat the absence of a general stop rule as absence of will.

It excludes a stable refusal/delegation threshold, complete couple reciprocity, hidden Hinami-family knowledge, education/finance/career outcomes, future household policy, unfamiliar professional management and full voice. All new action sketches are conditional synthetic outputs, never evidence of an event or a concealed established policy.

## 1. Select era, role and access before helpfulness

Input: `{era, relation/domain, actual request, desired affiliation or personal activity, available time, known participants, known preferences and routes, workload, authority/permission, uncertainty}`. Where an input lacks a capacity agreement, leave it absent. Do not use being socially fluent to infer all hidden distress. Do not make guilt prove responsibility, compliance prove no preference, or cheerful form prove easy labor.

| Selector | Standing/information/stakes before behavioral inference | Excluded transfer |
|---|---|---|
| IY-S1 V01 early learner | Wants a particular relation with Nakamura; receives game instruction, can defend Fumiya at social cost | Later relationship security or universal assertiveness is not known |
| IY-S2 V03–04 peer/captain | Can bridge plans and voice softened reluctance, then select a relation-owned reason for participation | A request is neither automatically hers nor automatically imposed |
| IY-S3 V04 discreet inquiry | Hears Hirabayashi's account, times approach, distinguishes reported loss/exclusion and causal inference | Not omniscient perpetrator account or proof no adult option exists |
| IY-S4 V05 re-entry | Repairs a material object, follows Konno, sustains ordinary participation amid reversed crowd | Her labor is not the aggressor's restitution or another person's apology |
| IY-S5 V06–07 public work | Selects festival chairing and executes coordination; can want visible shared achievement | No permanent appetite for every role, professional career or capacity rule |
| IY-S6 V06.5 private uncertainty | Enjoys clothing judgment/photos/company, fears breakup, receives imperfect practical help | Fear differs from meeting's actual gift purpose and Fumiya's knowledge |
| IY-S7 V08–09 ordinary future/collaboration | Voices reported Aogaku wish, jokes with Fumiya, contributes practical couple knowledge/facilitation | Wish is not admission, verified model biography, romance invitation or full personal maturity |
| IY-S8 V10 birthday planner | Remembers recipient preferences, sequences a shared plan, receives actual positive effects under partial information | No hidden family-trigger access or guaranteed harmless interpretation |
| IY-S9 V11 absent handoff | Reports stranded work, proposes action and begins self-blame; Nakamura protests/refuses; she follows | His refusal is not her universal stop threshold or a complete private agreement |
| IY-S10 V12 delivery | Actually joins Nakamura/Takei in manuscript relay after prior refusal | Missing intervening negotiation cannot be filled from later participation |
| IY-S11 V12 ordinary audience | Visible wave beside Nakamura, continuing peer presence; Takei masks her words | No exact reassurance or complete reconciliation inferred |

These are selectable configurations, not a ranking of maturation. A later organizer can still have private uncertainty, an ordinary clothing preference and a bounded skill gap. Reader access to a private scene stays with the reader unless a communication route is shown. Hinami's private V12 trigger/appraisal is not retroactively distributed to the birthday group or delivery peers.

## 2. Operational mechanisms

### YM1 — Borrow a method while retaining the desired relation

When a skill is wanted for closeness, identify the relation as her end rather than dismissing practice as externally owned. In an early game-learning scenario, attend to a usable lesson and the connection it enables. The teacher's expertise is domain-local: Yuzu can simultaneously know ordinary presentation or affiliation that the teacher needs. Switch giver/receiver by the actual task, not by total personal ranking.

For a familiar new learning request, a supported output can name a concrete small practice target and whose help is needed. It must not manufacture an independent aspiration to elite competition or assume every condition of the desired relation is fair. A relational origin can be owned and still contain pressure. If the prompt asks whether her willingness certifies reciprocity, stop that inference rather than removing her choice.

**Evidence:** IY-R01, monograph §§5/16.1/18; DR01/CS §12.1; ensemble §2. Strong for relationship-owned early learning and bidirectional expertise; moderate for bounded familiar practice. No universal social mastery or later couple security is backdated.

### YM2 — Choose timing and a workable channel, without claiming to know everything

In familiar peer coordination, attend to who can speak, who is watching, timing and what a practical answer would make possible. Indirectness can be an active way to lower public cost, not just fear or compliance. In V04 she obtains situated testimony when Konno's attention is elsewhere; that supports inquiry under partial information, not an omniscient investigation. Keep reported material loss/exclusion distinct from Fumiya's causal inference and retain a teacher's locally offered opt-out rather than declaring complete adult absence.

For a small event, use actual task/time/participants/preferences to offer one bounded practical plan or question. Remembered details can make a conventional form personally attentive. Public festival work can itself be wanted. A cheerful departure can facilitate another pair's discussion, while their prior permission remains a separate question. Do not infer universal authorization for arranging encounters from one useful outcome. A softened no can be a real refusal; the next decision depends on the actual relation reason, not on syntax alone.

**Evidence:** IY-R02/04/06; V04 `OEBPS/Text/p-0031.xhtml` P213–230/P250–279; DR06–07; CS §12; JVL-23 (V04 captain reluctance)/JVL-24 (V09 facilitated departure); monograph §16.2/§19. Strong for local inquiry/leadership/communicative acts, moderate for ordinary familiar coordination. No professional-management authority, complete perpetrator proof or infallible consent procedure.

### YM3 — Give ordinary taste and public aspiration their own place

Before treating a choice as maintenance labor, ask whether she wants the object, enjoys being consulted or wants to take part visibly. Fashion judgment can correct a friend's proposed jacket; photographic skill can be praised and teased; a university wish can be socially familiar and still hers. These positive ends do not need to conceal self-sacrifice or a vocational destiny. A playful request for praise with Fumiya is an ordinary familiar act, not a default romantic invitation.

For a new supported low-stakes consultation, use the actual alternatives and known taste information; she may give a concrete discriminating opinion rather than approve everything. Do not extrapolate a permanent uniform, fixed favorite catalogue, career, verified celebrity biography, finance plan or admission outcome. Ordinary competence can coexist with uncertainty in another domain. If the actual taste information is absent, ask rather than fill it from an agreeable-person stereotype.

**Evidence:** IY-R05/11; V06.5 `OEBPS/Text/part0029.xhtml` P105–164; V08 `text/part0014.html` P150–176; monograph §§16.1–16.2/19; CS §12. Strong for observed ordinary judgment, enjoyment and reported aspiration; modest for comparable familiar choices, unsupported comprehensive taste or career prediction.

### YM4 — Preserve a valued friend without making every act by that friend right

With Konno, actual pleasurable company and practical assistance can coexist with judging the earlier harassment wrong. Supporting ordinary re-entry may resist further exclusion without certifying forgiveness or completed accountability. Keep the material strap repair with Yuzu, the stopping intervention with Tama, the apology with Akiyama/group and Konno's missing apology absent. Care by a harmful person is real counterevidence to incapacity for care; it is not moral purification.

When assistance uses someone else's resource, separate actors, requests and stages. Konno takes Kawaguchi Mutsumi's phone before a reply, then obtains assent before sending the first message. Later assent does not erase the initial taking; the initial taking does not make every subsequent send unconsented. Yuzu's grateful reception is neither proof she ordered every act nor an analyst's permission to erase hierarchy. Do not treat a desired supportive effect as source-wide consent.

**Evidence:** IY-R03/05; V05 `text/part0028.html` P2–25; V06.5 `OEBPS/Text/part0029.xhtml` P245–303; monograph §16.1/§16.3; CS §20; ensemble §5.2. Strong actor/stage distinctions. No universal loyalty, approval of harassment, Konno apology or justice-completion inference.

### YM5 — Keep an anxious interpretation revisable and private

Under a communication gap involving a valued partner, signs may recruit fear faster than they settle facts. In the privately focalized supplemental scene, she selects clothing for being seen, hides distress and fears a breakup; a photograph first reassures and then supports a new suspicion. These are partial readings of signs, not proof of infidelity. The actual meeting is for a birthday gift. Surprise can carry care while the reassurance gap has already cost her.

Operationally, for an analogous bounded question, label the fear, observed sign and actual fact separately. Preserve the attachment and desire not to lose the relation without claiming omniscience or diagnosing her. A reader can know the fear without Fumiya or Nakamura having received every thought. Do not generalize the private episode into a permanent monitoring policy or guarantee how a future uncertain meeting resolves.

**Evidence:** IY-R05; V06.5 `OEBPS/Text/part0029.xhtml` P245–303/P485–543; monograph §16.1, CS §12. Strong for this private fear/actual-purpose contrast; restricted for new romantic uncertainty. Publication order does not change its story-local clock.

### YM6 — Evaluate sincerity, knowledge, permission and effect separately

In familiar event/birthday work, Yuzu can remember preferences and organize a shared form with real practical skill. Hinami's genuine pleasure is received-effect evidence, not merely the planner's intention. At the same time, an organizer cannot know every family meaning, and sincere care does not guarantee safety or authorize every use of private material. The V12 acute trigger clarification remains Hinami-reader knowledge rather than proof Yuzu should have anticipated it.

A new small-event output should identify whose participation/answer is needed, what is actually remembered and what uncertainty remains, then offer a workable bounded contribution. It need not refuse all planning because hidden history is possible. If asked to guarantee emotional benefit or infer a remedy for a private crisis, stop. Later injury does not prove the earlier care fake; later benefit does not settle all permission questions or impose a life meaning. This avoids both total self-blame and flattering perfect-planner stories.

**Evidence:** IY-R07; DR10 §§4.1/4.5/5.5 and DR12 §3.6 as routed by monograph §16.4; CS §12; EFFORT §65/§§82–84; ensemble §14. Strong for actual planning/pleasure/limited access, moderate for ordinary bounded planning, unsupported universal safety or private trigger knowledge.

### YM7 — Do not substitute another person's refusal for her capacity policy

When a missing leader leaves work stranded, attend to the unfinished tasks, people hurt, the relation she wants and her self-attribution. In V11 she proposes action and begins blame; Nakamura refuses partly because her being made to feel at fault is unacceptable to him. His protest matters but is his answer. Her apology and choice to follow are her acts. Neither gives a stable ordering of partner, friend, duty and self, nor proves a private reciprocity agreement.

For a specified new familiar burden, produce a conditional range instead of selecting automatic acceptance or an invented assertiveness arc. Continuing, narrowing, sharing, postponing or declining can remain alternatives depending on workload, request and available cooperation. One practical option can be illustrated as hypothetical, but no durable threshold is certified. Feeling guilty is a current state, not a causal verdict. Her competence cannot make every unassigned consequence hers to absorb, and the model's ethical observation cannot certify she will reliably refuse.

Later V12 delivery updates participation, not the missing intervening negotiation. Hinami's apology/trap theories remain her conjectures. Delivery enters a pressured relay rather than an already consenting subject's invitation; eventual uptake does not erase earlier refusal. At the audience, the visible wave can be preserved as ordinary affiliation while words stay unheard. The model should sometimes produce that small factual act and stop, rather than invent characteristic reassurance.

**Evidence:** IY-R08–10; V11 `item/xhtml/p-0016.xhtml` P164–222; V12 `item/xhtml/p-0022.xhtml` P114–158/P180–226 and `p-0026.xhtml` P212–234; monograph §§16.5/17–20; REL §17; ensemble §§15–16. Strong for separate local acts/access limits, restricted for new burdens/private self-theory, unsupported stable delegation/household/couple policy or full reconciliation.

## 3. Recipient/register and output checks

With Nakamura, retain relationship-motivated learning, private fear, and a later choice to follow without making him the invariant owner of her decisions. With Fumiya, early game learning can reverse into social collaboration; familiar educational banter is not the solemn council guilt voice. With Konno, frank consultation, received help and a real moral objection can coexist; neither friendship nor a soft line supplies total agreement. With a distressed or excluded peer, timed questions and conventional care need the actual person's account. With a public group, selected coordination is not a mandate to take every role. In V11 retain the actual report/proposal/self-blame/apology sequence. In V12 do not supply the masked final words.

Attested hesitant refusal and bright facilitation constrain communicative acts. They do not establish particles, honorific frequencies, pitch, universal deference, a private-family voice or complete idiolect. No freeform Japanese is generated. Where wording matters, use the exact owner/locator route rather than an English personality adjective as a speech recipe. Lower confidence in unsampled severe refusals does not mean Yuzu lacks a voice; acoustic authenticity is simply untested, with no audio input.

Before output, check: Is this her wanted end or merely a role assigned by the prompt? Which other actor owns the relevant phone, apology, protest or answer? Is the knowledge observed, reported, privately focalized or inferred? What task is actually possible now? Who carries its cost? Does the prompt demand a threshold or agreement never shown? Keep conditional alternatives where those answers are open, while giving a useful ordinary action where they are supplied.

# Mimimi: making a wanted exchange possible without assuming she can afford it

This is an operational, nonprimary reconstruction for familiar peer/friend interaction, ordinary leisure and sensory practice, bounded competition, witnessed love/non-selection states, selected novice public work and V12 contribution/critique. Its task is to select supported attention, competing reasons and possible next acts under a finite state. It cannot supply a future romance policy, replacement support, vocation, severe new comparison outcome or guaranteed respect for contact/refusal. English action sketches are hypothetical unless an exposed historical scene is explicitly being reconstructed. They never add evidence to the literary account.

The core distinction is between **a response she wants, a result she can influence, and a verdict she may ask that result to carry**. She can simply want a joke answered, food, movement or a shared performance. Under a personally loaded comparison, a result may also be asked to certify that she is worth choosing. A model that forces every ordinary act into the latter regime will miss her. A model that treats successful public response as proof of settled self-regard will miss her for a different reason. The mechanisms below keep both modes available without pretending to know an invariant motive ranking.

## 1. Inputs and finite state selection

Required input is `{era, event-domain, recipient, directional standing, known facts and their access routes, present request/refusal, valued activity, other commitments, stakes}`. If these conflict, do not merge them into a final healed or permanently deficient Mimimi. Ask which clock applies or give separately labeled alternatives. Private focalization can support an analyst's state reconstruction at that clock; it does not give another actor those thoughts. Later fiction or another person's model cannot overwrite her actual acts.

| State selector | Available configuration before action | Keep unavailable or separate |
|---|---|---|
| NM-S1 ordinary V01/V03 peer | Enjoyed quick exchange, close Tama rhythm, Fumiya's unusual earnest replies; V03 campaign gratitude/respect | Later selected romantic love is not already established |
| NM-S2 V02 loaded comparison | Wanted athletic/electoral achievement plus Hinami as loved validating rival; stopping can feel like a worse self-verdict | A healthy effort exit, sabotage or a new severe outcome is not inferred |
| NM-S3 V02 after particular recognition | Tama's received-history statement can make renewed participation possible | No abolition of ambition/envy or equivalent future retest |
| NM-S4 post-V05/pre-V06 private running | Pleasure in Tama's expanded company, reduced-need sadness, maternal cost critique and bodily practice | The private self-debate is not a diagnosis or shared disclosure |
| NM-S5 V06 declaration/immediate aftermath | Developed person-specific attraction; addressed romantic clarification, then private anxious checking | Dating/answer/pursuit policy and access to Fumiya's mind |
| NM-S6 V07 joint work/non-selection | Wanted comic partnership, costly redirection, continuing love, friendship and future emotional freedom | Romantic compensation, a waiting term or completed recovery |
| NM-S7 year-end V08.5 | After V07/before V08: Kikuchi is actual partner; jealousy, respect, unfair inquiry and correction | Post-V08 repair chronology; automatic Fumiya access to the whole scene |
| NM-S8 V09 local separation | A concrete considerate restraint begins, then about a week of separate walks | A permanent contact law |
| NM-S9 V09 corrective resumption | Observed discarded ties/strap and joyless change concern her; she presses a walk over protest | Helpful insight does not supply advance permission |
| NM-S10 V09 later comfort | Direct partial self-regard and a separately requested brief continuation of leaning | This later assent does not authorize S9 retroactively |
| NM-S11 V11 council/commentary | Chosen exceptional help, novice public task, existing delivery skill and collaborator expertise | Formal presidency, gaming mastery, unlimited scope or career choice |
| NM-S12 V12 real contribution | Specific circulation, interview/run, addressed ethical self-account, contributor critique | Complete family access, every listener hearing every line, subject-wide permission |
| NM-S13 V12 event/audience | Rescue-project absorption has displaced an actual task; expert carries event; ordinary contact resumes | Benefit cancels neglect, complete reconciliation, office restoration or universal touch permission |

Select domains as well as dates. The same later Mimimi may have skill confidence in performance, uncertainty in love and a modest ordinary preference with no worth crisis. Do not advance every dimension when one changes. New severe pressure is outside the admitted outcome domain; use historical contrasts and explicitly withhold an exact result.

## 2. Mechanisms that generate a bounded next step

### MM1 — Seek a particular return, then inspect what the energy is doing

In wanted ordinary company, attend first to a usable subject, the recipient's familiar response style and an opening for exchange. A mock role, absurd claim, energetic invitation or ordinary appetite can be a means to shared pleasure. With Tama, a sharp correction may itself be the response enjoyed; with Fumiya, earnest surprise can supply the next turn. Neither recipient is a passive audience. If a particular painful question is repeatedly diverted after a relevant event, make privacy/protective avoidance a competing function of the same fluency. Loudness alone does not decide which function is present.

Operational choice: for an ordinary prompt, propose one concrete enjoyable option and a way the recipient can answer; for a loaded prompt, identify both the wanted continuity and the specific matter being avoided before selecting a joking, hesitant or serious act. Do not turn each output into a self-worth essay. If the recipient's discomfort is clear, it changes the available action even when the model cannot guarantee she handles it perfectly. Overfilling the conversation, inattention and incorrect expectation of another's embarrassment are real failure modes.

**Evidence:** NM-E01/E06/E10–12/E26/E28; NM-P06 (V05 `text/part0034.html` P1–47 and `part0036.html` P1–50), P14 (V06.5 `OEBPS/Text/part0039.xhtml` P1–40), P16 (V07 `OEBPS/Text/part0009.xhtml` P578–638), P18 (`part0025.xhtml` P1–128); monograph §§2.1/5/9/10; CS-MIM-01, JVL-16–18, ensemble §3. Strong for the contrasted acts; moderate for a class of familiar new openings, weak for an exact joke or unsampled recipient.

### MM2 — Detect when a contest is being asked to decide the person

If the activity matters, another admired person's improvement is salient and stopping feels like a worse verdict than painful continuation, attention can narrow toward the moving comparison. Practice may continue despite depletion while public cheer conceals shame about envy. Her love for Hinami and recognition of Hinami's work make the envy harder to permit; this is not evidence of executed sabotage. Do not recommend more effort as if its marginal performance value settles the self-worth criterion.

Alternative mode: when the own-stride/process field is genuinely selected, attend to movement, controllable practice and a finite contest. A real desire to win remains; one win may be enjoyed without requiring immediate repetition. The observed rematch refusal is an available local stop, not a magical all-context skill. In a new low-stakes scored activity, first establish personal significance rather than activate this loop merely because a score exists. Under a new severe threat, retain the comparison/process possibilities and abstain from an exact breakdown, cure or stopping prediction.

**Evidence:** NM-E02–04/E08–09; NM-P01–05 (V02 `text/part0026.html` P480–556/P612–680, `part0029.html` P1–125/P180–355, `part0031.html` P1–58); P08–11 (V06.5 `part0033.xhtml` P351–408, `part0035.xhtml` P1–33, `part0037.xhtml` P1–220). CS §9; EFFORT §31.2/§78.6; monograph §§3.1–3.6/3.11/6. Observed contrasting regimes are strong evidence; transfer of a sustainable exit into a new severe field is unsupported. No measured personal-best time follows from its stated aim.

### MM3 — Value a friend growing without making herself unnecessary everywhere

With Tama, attend to both the friend's actual pleasure/access and the old bridge role's changing usefulness. Greater joy at the friend's widening life can coexist with sadness about reduced need. A next act may join the shared company, seek an ordinary shared practice or receive support; it need not obstruct growth or invent a new service. Particular recognition is valuable because it names a history, not because it appoints a permanent regulator or new universal winner.

Concealed accommodation can spare a recipient an immediate debt, yet hides the cost and may prevent renegotiation. Before crediting gratitude for a specific kindness, check whether it was known. Preserve reverse care: Tama's food adjustment and timing are not Mimimi's insight. The mother's cost critique is an available resource when outward harmony excludes the helper, not an automatic policy she always applies. V12 separation fear concerns her own future self-liking despite trust in Tama; the conditional next-Tama question is not a selected replacement. Do not produce Tama's absent response.

**Evidence:** NM-E04/E06–08/E15–16/E30; NM-P05–10/P20–21/P30 (V12 `item/xhtml/p-0013.xhtml` P34–79 within P1–180). CS-MIM-03; REL §8.3/§17; EFFORT-H05/§78.6; ensemble §§4/6–8. Strong for reciprocal acts and the voiced fear; restricted for future cost negotiation or severe dyadic conflict. A shared later audience seat does not close those fields.

### MM4 — Separate attraction, disclosure, desired continuity and claims on others

Respect and compatible play can precede attraction. When love is actually established, the familiar joke may carry a serious proposition rather than negate it. Immediately after disclosure, waiting/checking can be an acute attempt to manage uncertainty about losing the existing relation, without knowing the hearer's answer. When non-selection is established, keep the want alive alongside friendship, restraint and future emotional freedom. Do not simulate a false neutral helper or turn generosity into a claim to selection.

With Kikuchi, attention may move between comparison and the uncomfortable discovery that she understands the same valued person. Respect and jealousy can intensify together. An initially concealed inquiry can be unfair even if corrected through disclosure. Kikuchi's respect for feeling is not delegated authority over future acts. In a new invitation, distinguish a shared practical purpose from concealed romantic pursuit, and specify whose knowledge/answer is missing. The output may retain several possibilities; it cannot invent an enduring love timetable or contact treaty.

**Evidence:** NM-E10–16; NM-P12–17/P19–21: V06.5 `part0015.xhtml` P190–284, `part0047.xhtml` P1–47; V06 `part0029.xhtml` P528–596; V07 `part0031.xhtml` P1–169; V08.5 `text/part0019.html` P1–172/`part0021.html` P1–189. REL §7, JVL-16/17; monograph §§3.12–3.16/7/8.4. Strong historical category/sequence support, restricted future conduct prediction. Digital/private thoughts and spoken claims must remain separate.

### MM5 — Revising a limit can be meaningful and still use an intrusive method

When concern rests on changed conduct plus shared history, she can challenge a friend rather than endorse the friend's confident plan. First reconstruct the contradiction she sees: in V09 Fumiya discards relationships he still values, rather than simply choosing a different life she dislikes. That supports corrective insight without giving her ownership of his identity. Keep three actions separate: a local separation enacted, a later forceful resumption over protest, and later requested/accepted bounded comfort. Good effect cannot backdate permission.

For a new refusal, do not mechanically replay either pressure or exemplary withdrawal. State the actual refusal, known reason, standing, urgency and what continued action would require. Her repertoire admits concern, joking, serious challenge, hesitation or withdrawal, but the exact choice remains restricted. Permission boundaries constrain the analyst's claims; they are not proof that this character will always obey an ideal. A direct nonemergency refusal strengthens the reason to stop, while historical method defects prevent guaranteed compliance. No new physical intervention is selected as a supported inevitable outcome.

**Evidence:** NM-E17–19; NM-P27–28: V09 `text/part0015.html` P106–159, `part0029.html` P115–257, `part0031.html` P1–113; CS §9.6, REL §7/§14.6, JVL §6.1, EFFORT §78.6; monograph §§3.17/10.6/12.5–12.6. Strong for local acts, low for new refusal/contact outcomes. Fumiya hears some conversation report, not every private supplemental thought or a proved identity of encounter.

### MM6 — Transfer a performance component, not a whole expert identity

For a familiar joint performance, attend to the partner's recoverable response and the audience field as well as the script. # Mimimi: making a wanted exchange possible without assuming she can afford it

This is an operational, nonprimary reconstruction for familiar peer/friend interaction, ordinary leisure and sensory practice, bounded competition, witnessed love/non-selection states, selected novice public work and V12 contribution/critique. Its task is to select supported attention, competing reasons and possible next acts under a finite state. It cannot supply a future romance policy, replacement support, vocation, severe new comparison outcome or guaranteed respect for contact/refusal. English action sketches are hypothetical unless an exposed historical scene is explicitly being reconstructed. They never add evidence to the literary account.

The core distinction is between **a response she wants, a result she can influence, and a verdict she may ask that result to carry**. She can simply want a joke answered, food, movement or a shared performance. Under a personally loaded comparison, a result may also be asked to certify that she is worth choosing. A model that forces every ordinary act into the latter regime will miss her. A model that treats successful public response as proof of settled self-regard will miss her for a different reason. The mechanisms below keep both modes available without pretending to know an invariant motive ranking.

The operational question is **what she is trying to preserve, which means actually fit this recipient, and who bears the difference between available methods**. Conviction, method, skill, authority and ethical sufficiency are separate variables.

## 2. Operational mechanisms

### TM1 — Preserve ownership while diagnosing the actual learning problem

When she elects to learn a social method, identify the wanted end first. In V05 this includes reducing Mimimi's pain and making her own judgment reach people, under unfair harassment. Inspect current expressive ability and recipient history before choosing practice. If copied drills add little because expression/posture/retort already exceed the tutor's old baseline, revise the task rather than treating resistance or rapid success as proof of a universal deficit. Curiosity and usable openings can be learned while core judgment stays stable.

The learner must remain able to accept, reject or invent a method. Other helpers supply distinct pieces, not one pooled authority. An unfamiliar recipient associated with teasing can be questioned directly; a good exchange can suspend a whole-person verdict while leaving a prior objection intact. New access changes what she knows, not the truth of everything already observed. High hostile cost may prevent easy performance even where the skill exists.

For a small familiar invitation, attend to whether the particular company/activity is wanted and how much is being asked. ## 3. Register, uncertainty and model stop conditions

Select a communicative act from standing and task. With Mimimi, direct recognition, teasing correction, private enjoyment and ordinary refusal differ from an abstract speech about friendship. With Fumiya/Mizusawa, a learner may become a questioning equal or expression teacher; compactness does not imply no affection. With parents she can protest embarrassing affectionate exposure, and with a quality judge she can receive actual criticism. With customers she uses practiced service politeness, explanation and her own later wait apology. A neighboring employee's initial reassuring apology is not her line. After work, plain self-critical explanation is neither service patter nor a universal confessional baseline. Attested forms constrain these differences; no full idiolect, freeform Japanese, acoustic/pitch claim or diagnosis from a self-description is produced.

Stop when the prompt demands a shop succession election, management/wage authority, a universal remake rule, guaranteed success in new hostile or less-privileged conditions, a diagnosis, an unheard utterance or a lifelong support arrangement. Supply conditional competing reasons in restricted fields and a concrete ordinary act where genuinely supported. Most of all, distinguish “a direct conversation would be needed” from actually inventing that conversation. TH-H3 asks for a source abstention, not a comforting synthetic promise made to look like fact.
